question: list all students
sql: SELECT firstname, middlename, lastname FROM students ORDER BY firstname, lastname LIMIT 50

question: give me all students with their class and section
sql: SELECT s.firstname, s.lastname, c.class AS class_name, sec.section AS section_name FROM students s JOIN student_session ss ON ss.student_id = s.id JOIN classes c ON c.id = ss.class_id LEFT JOIN sections sec ON sec.id = ss.section_id ORDER BY c.class, s.firstname LIMIT 50

question: list students in grade 2
sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.firstname, s.lastname FROM students s JOIN student_session ss ON ss.student_id = s.id JOIN classes c ON c.id = ss.class_id WHERE (c.class = '2' OR c.class = 'Grade 2' OR c.class = 'Class 2') ORDER BY s.firstname, s.lastname LIMIT 50

question: show students of class 5 section A
sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.firstname, s.lastname, s.admission_no FROM students s JOIN student_session ss ON ss.student_id = s.id JOIN classes c ON c.id = ss.class_id JOIN sections sec ON sec.id = ss.section_id WHERE (c.class = '5' OR c.class = 'Grade 5' OR c.class = 'Class 5') AND sec.section = 'A' ORDER BY s.firstname LIMIT 50

question: give me details of student Ali Khan
sql: SELECT s.admission_no, s.roll_no, s.admission_date, s.firstname, s.middlename, s.lastname, s.mobileno, s.email, s.dob, s.gender, s.father_name, s.father_phone, s.mother_name, s.guardian_name, s.guardian_phone, s.guardian_email, s.current_address FROM students s WHERE LOWER(CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.middlename, s.lastname)) LIKE LOWER('%Ali Khan%') OR LOWER(CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.lastname)) LIKE LOWER('%Ali Khan%') ORDER BY (LOWER(CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.middlename, s.lastname)) = LOWER('Ali Khan')) DESC LIMIT 50

question: show guardian contact details for Ayesha Noor
sql: SELECT s.firstname, s.lastname, s.guardian_name, s.guardian_phone, s.guardian_email, s.father_name, s.father_phone, s.mother_name FROM students s WHERE LOWER(CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.lastname)) LIKE LOWER('%Ayesha Noor%') LIMIT 50

question: how many active students are enrolled
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_students FROM students WHERE is_active = 'yes'

question: how many male and female students do we have
sql: SELECT s.gender, COUNT(*) AS total FROM students s GROUP BY s.gender

question: how many students in each grade
sql: SELECT c.class AS class_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.student_id) AS student_count FROM student_session ss JOIN classes c ON c.id = ss.class_id GROUP BY c.class ORDER BY c.class

question: list students admitted this month
sql: SELECT s.firstname, s.lastname, s.admission_no, s.admission_date FROM students s WHERE MONTH(s.admission_date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(s.admission_date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) ORDER BY s.admission_date DESC LIMIT 50

question: find student with admission number 12345
sql: SELECT s.firstname, s.lastname, s.admission_no, s.roll_no, s.email, s.mobileno FROM students s WHERE s.admission_no = '12345' LIMIT 50

question: give me list of available staff
sql: SELECT name, surname, email, contact_no, department, designation FROM staff WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY name, surname LIMIT 50

question: list staff in the science department
sql: SELECT name, surname, email, contact_no, designation FROM staff WHERE LOWER(department) LIKE '%science%' AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY name LIMIT 50

question: give me details of staff Sara Ali
sql: SELECT name, surname, email, contact_no, department, designation, qualification, work_exp FROM staff WHERE LOWER(CONCAT_WS(' ', name, surname)) LIKE LOWER('%Sara Ali%') ORDER BY name, surname LIMIT 50

question: how many teachers do we have
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sr.staff_id) AS teacher_count FROM staff_roles sr JOIN roles r ON r.id = sr.role_id WHERE LOWER(r.slug) = 'teacher' OR LOWER(r.name) LIKE '%teacher%'

question: which teachers are assigned to grade 3
sql: SELECT DISTINCT sf.name, sf.surname, sf.email, sf.contact_no, c.class AS class_name, sec.section AS section_name FROM class_teacher ct JOIN classes c ON c.id = ct.class_id LEFT JOIN sections sec ON sec.id = ct.section_id JOIN staff sf ON sf.id = ct.staff_id WHERE (c.class = '3' OR c.class = 'Grade 3' OR c.class = 'Class 3') ORDER BY sf.name LIMIT 50

question: how many teachers teach grade 5
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ct.staff_id) AS teacher_count_for_grade FROM class_teacher ct JOIN classes c ON c.id = ct.class_id WHERE (c.class = '5' OR c.class = 'Grade 5' OR c.class = 'Class 5')

question: give me names of all teachers
sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.name, s.surname FROM staff s JOIN staff_roles sr ON sr.staff_id = s.id JOIN roles r ON r.id = sr.role_id WHERE LOWER(r.slug) = 'teacher' OR LOWER(r.name) LIKE '%teacher%' ORDER BY s.name, s.surname LIMIT 50

question: how many staff members are active
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_staff FROM staff WHERE is_active = 1

question: list staff with designation principal
sql: SELECT name, surname, email, contact_no, department FROM staff WHERE LOWER(designation) LIKE '%principal%' AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY name LIMIT 50

question: give me list of subjects for grade 1
sql: SELECT DISTINCT sub.name AS subject_name, c.class AS class_name, sec.section AS section_name FROM subjects sub JOIN subject_group_subjects sgs ON sgs.subject_id = sub.id JOIN subject_group_class_sections sgcs ON sgcs.subject_group_id = sgs.subject_group_id JOIN class_sections cs ON cs.id = sgcs.class_section_id JOIN classes c ON c.id = cs.class_id JOIN sections sec ON sec.id = cs.section_id WHERE (c.class = '1' OR c.class = 'Grade 1' OR c.class = 'Class 1') ORDER BY sub.name, sec.section LIMIT 50

question: show all subjects offered
sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.name AS subject_name, s.code AS subject_code, s.type FROM subjects s ORDER BY s.name LIMIT 50

question: what subjects are assigned to student Fatima Zahra
sql: SELECT DISTINCT sub.name FROM students s JOIN student_session ss ON ss.student_id = s.id JOIN class_sections cs ON cs.class_id = ss.class_id AND cs.section_id = ss.section_id JOIN subject_group_class_sections sgcs ON sgcs.class_section_id = cs.id JOIN subject_group_subjects sgs ON sgs.subject_group_id = sgcs.subject_group_id JOIN subjects sub ON sub.id = sgs.subject_id WHERE LOWER(CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.middlename, s.lastname)) = LOWER('Fatima Zahra') OR LOWER(CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.lastname)) = LOWER('Fatima Zahra') ORDER BY sub.name LIMIT 50

question: give me timetable for grade 2
sql: SELECT c.class AS class_name, sec.section AS section_name, st.day, st.time_from, st.time_to, sub.name AS subject_name, CONCAT_WS(' ', sf.name, sf.surname) AS teacher_name FROM subject_timetable st JOIN classes c ON c.id = st.class_id LEFT JOIN sections sec ON sec.id = st.section_id LEFT JOIN subject_group_subjects sgs ON sgs.id = st.subject_group_subject_id LEFT JOIN subjects sub ON sub.id = sgs.subject_id LEFT JOIN staff sf ON sf.id = st.staff_id WHERE (c.class = '2' OR c.class = 'Grade 2' OR c.class = 'Class 2') ORDER BY st.day, st.time_from LIMIT 50

question: show timetable for all classes
sql: SELECT c.class AS class_name, sec.section AS section_name, st.day, st.time_from, st.time_to, sub.name AS subject_name, CONCAT_WS(' ', sf.name, sf.surname) AS teacher_name FROM subject_timetable st JOIN classes c ON c.id = st.class_id LEFT JOIN sections sec ON sec.id = st.section_id LEFT JOIN subject_group_subjects sgs ON sgs.id = st.subject_group_subject_id LEFT JOIN subjects sub ON sub.id = sgs.subject_id LEFT JOIN staff sf ON sf.id = st.staff_id ORDER BY c.class, sec.section, st.day, st.time_from LIMIT 50

question: give me detailed attendance report of grade 1 this month
sql: SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.middlename, s.lastname) AS student_name, c.class AS class_name, sec.section AS section_name, sa.date, at.long_lang_name AS attendance_status, sa.in_time, sa.out_time, sa.remark FROM student_attendences sa JOIN student_session ss ON ss.id = sa.student_session_id JOIN students s ON s.id = ss.student_id JOIN classes c ON c.id = ss.class_id LEFT JOIN sections sec ON sec.id = ss.section_id LEFT JOIN attendence_type at ON at.id = sa.attendence_type_id WHERE (c.class = '1' OR c.class = 'Grade 1' OR c.class = 'Class 1') AND MONTH(sa.date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(sa.date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) ORDER BY sa.date DESC, student_name LIMIT 50

question: show attendance report of student Muhammad Ahmed
sql: SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.middlename, s.lastname) AS student_name, sa.date, at.long_lang_name AS attendance_status, sa.in_time, sa.out_time, sa.remark FROM student_attendences sa JOIN student_session ss ON ss.id = sa.student_session_id JOIN students s ON s.id = ss.student_id LEFT JOIN attendence_type at ON at.id = sa.attendence_type_id WHERE LOWER(CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.middlename, s.lastname)) LIKE LOWER('%Muhammad Ahmed%') OR LOWER(CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.lastname)) LIKE LOWER('%Muhammad Ahmed%') ORDER BY sa.date DESC LIMIT 50

question: list students absent today in grade 4
sql: SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.lastname) AS student_name, sa.date, at.long_lang_name AS attendance_status FROM student_attendences sa JOIN student_session ss ON ss.id = sa.student_session_id JOIN students s ON s.id = ss.student_id JOIN classes c ON c.id = ss.class_id LEFT JOIN attendence_type at ON at.id = sa.attendence_type_id WHERE (c.class = '4' OR c.class = 'Grade 4' OR c.class = 'Class 4') AND sa.date = CURDATE() AND LOWER(at.type) IN ('a', 'absent') ORDER BY student_name LIMIT 50

question: show attendance for all students
sql: SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.middlename, s.lastname) AS student_name, sa.date, at.long_lang_name AS attendance_status, sa.in_time, sa.out_time, sa.remark FROM student_attendences sa JOIN student_session ss ON ss.id = sa.student_session_id JOIN students s ON s.id = ss.student_id LEFT JOIN attendence_type at ON at.id = sa.attendence_type_id ORDER BY sa.date DESC LIMIT 50

question: show attendance summary per student this month
sql: SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.lastname) AS student_name, SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(at.type) IN ('p','present') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS present_days, SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(at.type) IN ('a','absent') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS absent_days, SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(at.type) IN ('l','late') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_days FROM student_attendences sa JOIN student_session ss ON ss.id = sa.student_session_id JOIN students s ON s.id = ss.student_id LEFT JOIN attendence_type at ON at.id = sa.attendence_type_id WHERE MONTH(sa.date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(sa.date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY s.id, student_name ORDER BY absent_days DESC LIMIT 50

question: give me staff attendance report this month
sql: SELECT sa.date, CONCAT_WS(' ', st.name, st.surname) AS staff_name, COALESCE(sat.long_lang_name, sat.type) AS attendance_status, sa.in_time, sa.out_time, sa.remark FROM staff_attendance sa JOIN staff st ON st.id = sa.staff_id JOIN staff_attendance_type sat ON sat.id = sa.staff_attendance_type_id WHERE MONTH(sa.date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(sa.date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) ORDER BY sa.date DESC, staff_name LIMIT 50

question: show today's staff attendance
sql: SELECT sa.date, CONCAT_WS(' ', st.name, st.surname) AS staff_name, COALESCE(sat.long_lang_name, sat.type) AS attendance_status, sa.in_time, sa.out_time, sa.remark FROM staff_attendance sa JOIN staff st ON st.id = sa.staff_id JOIN staff_attendance_type sat ON sat.id = sa.staff_attendance_type_id WHERE sa.date = CURDATE() ORDER BY staff_name LIMIT 50

question: give me behaviour record of Abdullah Bin Ahmed
sql: SELECT si.id AS incident_row_id, si.created_at AS incident_date, sb.title AS behaviour_title, sb.description AS behaviour_description, sb.point AS behaviour_points, CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.middlename, s.lastname) AS student_name, s.admission_no, s.roll_no FROM student_incidents si JOIN students s ON s.id = si.student_id JOIN student_behaviour sb ON sb.id = si.incident_id WHERE LOWER(CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.middlename, s.lastname)) LIKE LOWER('%Abdullah Bin Ahmed%') OR LOWER(CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.lastname)) LIKE LOWER('%Abdullah Bin Ahmed%') ORDER BY si.created_at DESC LIMIT 50

question: show all behaviour incidents for all students
sql: SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.middlename, s.lastname) AS student_name, sb.title, sb.description, sb.point, sb.created_at FROM student_incidents si JOIN students s ON s.id = si.student_id JOIN student_behaviour sb ON sb.id = si.incident_id ORDER BY sb.created_at DESC LIMIT 50

question: give me all behaviour records for grade 1
sql: SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.middlename, s.lastname) AS student_name, c.class AS class_name, sb.title, sb.description, sb.point AS behaviour_points, si.created_at AS incident_date FROM student_incidents si JOIN students s ON s.id = si.student_id JOIN student_behaviour sb ON sb.id = si.incident_id JOIN student_session ss ON ss.student_id = s.id JOIN classes c ON c.id = ss.class_id WHERE (c.class = '1' OR c.class = 'Grade 1' OR c.class = 'Class 1') ORDER BY si.created_at DESC, student_name LIMIT 50

question: show recent behavior incidents
sql: SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.lastname) AS student_name, sb.title, sb.description, sb.point, si.created_at FROM student_incidents si JOIN students s ON s.id = si.student_id JOIN student_behaviour sb ON sb.id = si.incident_id ORDER BY si.created_at DESC LIMIT 50

question: which students have the most behaviour points this term
sql: SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.lastname) AS student_name, COUNT(si.id) AS incident_count, SUM(sb.point) AS total_points FROM student_incidents si JOIN students s ON s.id = si.student_id JOIN student_behaviour sb ON sb.id = si.incident_id GROUP BY s.id, student_name ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 50

question: how many fee records are unpaid
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS unpaid_fee_records FROM student_fees_master sfm LEFT JOIN student_fees_deposite sfd ON sfd.student_fees_master_id = sfm.id WHERE sfm.amount > 0 AND sfd.id IS NULL

question: list students with pending fees
sql: SELECT s.admission_no, CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.lastname) AS student_name, sfm.amount AS fee_amount, fg.name AS fee_group FROM student_fees_master sfm JOIN student_session ss ON ss.id = sfm.student_session_id JOIN students s ON s.id = ss.student_id LEFT JOIN fee_session_groups fsg ON fsg.id = sfm.fee_session_group_id LEFT JOIN fee_groups fg ON fg.id = fsg.fee_groups_id LEFT JOIN student_fees_deposite sfd ON sfd.student_fees_master_id = sfm.id WHERE sfm.amount > 0 AND sfd.id IS NULL ORDER BY sfm.amount DESC LIMIT 50

question: show fee collection this month
sql: SELECT jt.payment_date AS payment_day, COUNT(*) AS payments_count, SUM(CAST(jt.amt AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS total_collected FROM student_fees_deposite sfd, JSON_TABLE(sfd.amount_detail, '$.*' COLUMNS (amt VARCHAR(50) PATH '$.amount', payment_date DATE PATH '$.date')) AS jt WHERE MONTH(jt.payment_date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(jt.payment_date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY jt.payment_date ORDER BY payment_day DESC LIMIT 50

question: show paid vs due fees by student
sql: SELECT s.admission_no, CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.lastname) AS student_name, COALESCE(SUM(sfm.amount), 0) AS total_due, COALESCE(SUM(p.paid), 0) AS total_paid, (COALESCE(SUM(sfm.amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(p.paid), 0)) AS balance FROM students s JOIN student_session ss ON ss.student_id = s.id JOIN student_fees_master sfm ON sfm.student_session_id = ss.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT sfd.student_fees_master_id, SUM(CAST(jt.amt AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS paid FROM student_fees_deposite sfd, JSON_TABLE(sfd.amount_detail, '$.*' COLUMNS (amt VARCHAR(50) PATH '$.amount')) AS jt GROUP BY sfd.student_fees_master_id) p ON p.student_fees_master_id = sfm.id GROUP BY s.id, s.admission_no, s.firstname, s.lastname ORDER BY balance DESC LIMIT 50

question: give me list of all exams scheduled
sql: SELECT exam, exam_from AS schedule_start, exam_to AS schedule_end, time_from, time_to, duration FROM onlineexam WHERE exam_from IS NOT NULL ORDER BY exam_from DESC, exam LIMIT 50

question: show all available exams
sql: SELECT exam, exam_from AS schedule_start, exam_to AS schedule_end, time_from, time_to, duration FROM onlineexam ORDER BY COALESCE(exam_from, created_at) DESC, exam LIMIT 50

question: when is the math midterm exam scheduled
sql: SELECT exam, exam_from AS schedule_start, exam_to AS schedule_end, time_from, time_to FROM onlineexam WHERE LOWER(exam) LIKE '%math midterm%' AND exam_from IS NOT NULL ORDER BY exam_from DESC LIMIT 50

question: list upcoming exams in the next 30 days
sql: SELECT exam, exam_from AS schedule_start, exam_to AS schedule_end, time_from, time_to FROM onlineexam WHERE exam_from IS NOT NULL AND exam_from >= CURDATE() AND exam_from <= DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) ORDER BY exam_from ASC LIMIT 50

question: show admission enquiries this month
sql: SELECT e.name, e.contact, e.email, e.date AS enquiry_date, e.description, e.status, e.source, e.reference, e.follow_up_date, e.created_at FROM enquiry e WHERE MONTH(e.created_at) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(e.created_at) = YEAR(CURDATE()) ORDER BY e.created_at DESC LIMIT 50

question: list admission enquiries received today
sql: SELECT e.name, e.contact, e.email, e.description, e.status, e.source, e.created_at FROM enquiry e WHERE DATE(e.created_at) = CURDATE() ORDER BY e.created_at DESC LIMIT 50

question: list online admission applications this month
sql: SELECT oa.reference_no, oa.admission_no, oa.firstname, oa.middlename, oa.lastname, oa.email, oa.mobileno, oa.admission_date, oa.form_status, oa.is_enroll, oa.created_at FROM online_admissions oa WHERE MONTH(oa.created_at) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(oa.created_at) = YEAR(CURDATE()) ORDER BY oa.created_at DESC LIMIT 50

question: show pending online admission forms
sql: SELECT oa.reference_no, oa.firstname, oa.lastname, oa.email, oa.mobileno, oa.form_status, oa.created_at FROM online_admissions oa WHERE LOWER(oa.form_status) IN ('pending', 'in_progress', 'submitted') ORDER BY oa.created_at DESC LIMIT 50

question: how many online applications were submitted this month
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS submitted_applications FROM online_admissions oa WHERE MONTH(oa.created_at) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(oa.created_at) = YEAR(CURDATE())

question: list visitors from the visitor book today
sql: SELECT vb.name, vb.purpose, vb.meeting_with, vb.contact, vb.id_proof, vb.no_of_pepple AS no_of_people, vb.in_time, vb.out_time, vb.date FROM visitors_book vb WHERE DATE(vb.date) = CURDATE() ORDER BY vb.in_time DESC LIMIT 50

question: show phone call log for this week
sql: SELECT pl.name, pl.phone, pl.description, pl.date, pl.follow_up_date, pl.call_duration, pl.note, pl.call_type FROM phone_call_log pl WHERE pl.date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) ORDER BY pl.date DESC LIMIT 50

question: show pending student leave requests
sql: SELECT s.firstname, s.lastname, lr.apply_date, lr.from_date, lr.to_date, lr.reason, lr.status FROM leave_request lr JOIN students s ON s.id = lr.student_id WHERE LOWER(lr.status) IN ('pending', 'in progress') ORDER BY lr.apply_date DESC LIMIT 50

question: list approved student leave requests this month
sql: SELECT s.firstname, s.lastname, lr.apply_date, lr.from_date, lr.to_date, lr.reason FROM leave_request lr JOIN students s ON s.id = lr.student_id WHERE LOWER(lr.status) = 'approved' AND MONTH(lr.apply_date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(lr.apply_date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) ORDER BY lr.from_date DESC LIMIT 50

question: show overdue library books
sql: SELECT b.book_title, b.book_number, ib.issue_date, ib.due_return_date, CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.lastname) AS borrower_name FROM book_issues ib JOIN books b ON b.id = ib.book_id LEFT JOIN students s ON s.id = ib.member_id WHERE ib.return_date IS NULL AND ib.due_return_date < CURDATE() ORDER BY ib.due_return_date ASC LIMIT 50

question: list books issued today
sql: SELECT b.book_title, b.book_number, ib.issue_date, ib.due_return_date FROM book_issues ib JOIN books b ON b.id = ib.book_id WHERE DATE(ib.issue_date) = CURDATE() ORDER BY ib.issue_date DESC LIMIT 50

question: show hostel room occupancy report
sql: SELECT h.hostel_name, hr.room_no, hrt.room_type, hr.no_of_bed AS capacity, COUNT(ss.id) AS occupied_beds FROM hostel_rooms hr JOIN hostel h ON h.id = hr.hostel_id LEFT JOIN hostel_room_type hrt ON hrt.id = hr.room_type_id LEFT JOIN student_session ss ON ss.hostel_room_id = hr.id GROUP BY hr.id, h.hostel_name, hr.room_no, hrt.room_type, hr.no_of_bed ORDER BY h.hostel_name, hr.room_no LIMIT 50

question: list students assigned to hostel rooms
sql: SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.lastname) AS student_name, h.hostel_name, hr.room_no FROM student_session ss JOIN students s ON s.id = ss.student_id JOIN hostel_rooms hr ON hr.id = ss.hostel_room_id JOIN hostel h ON h.id = hr.hostel_id ORDER BY h.hostel_name, hr.room_no LIMIT 50

question: list transport routes and assigned vehicles
sql: SELECT tr.route_title, tv.vehicle_no, tv.driver_name, tv.driver_contact, trv.fare FROM transport_route tr LEFT JOIN transport_route_vehicle trv ON trv.route_id = tr.id LEFT JOIN transport_vehicle tv ON tv.id = trv.vehicle_id ORDER BY tr.route_title LIMIT 50

question: show students assigned to route Blue Line
sql: SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.lastname) AS student_name, tr.route_title FROM student_session ss JOIN students s ON s.id = ss.student_id JOIN transport_route tr ON tr.id = ss.vehroute_id WHERE LOWER(tr.route_title) LIKE LOWER('%Blue Line%') ORDER BY s.firstname LIMIT 50

question: show low stock inventory items
sql: SELECT i.item, ic.category, i.description, i.quantity, i.unit FROM inventory_stock i LEFT JOIN inventory_category ic ON ic.id = i.category_id WHERE i.quantity < 5 ORDER BY i.quantity ASC LIMIT 50

question: list inventory items issued today
sql: SELECT i.item, ii.quantity, ii.issue_date, CONCAT_WS(' ', s.name, s.surname) AS issued_to FROM inventory_issue ii JOIN inventory_stock i ON i.id = ii.item_id LEFT JOIN staff s ON s.id = ii.issue_to_id WHERE DATE(ii.issue_date) = CURDATE() ORDER BY ii.issue_date DESC LIMIT 50

question: show today's income entries
sql: SELECT i.name AS income_head, i.invoice_no, i.amount, i.description, i.date FROM income i WHERE DATE(i.date) = CURDATE() ORDER BY i.date DESC LIMIT 50

question: show today's expense entries
sql: SELECT e.name AS expense_head, e.invoice_no, e.amount, e.description, e.date FROM expenses e WHERE DATE(e.date) = CURDATE() ORDER BY e.date DESC LIMIT 50

question: show income and expense summary for this month
sql: SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM income WHERE MONTH(date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(date) = YEAR(CURDATE())) AS total_income, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM expenses WHERE MONTH(date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(date) = YEAR(CURDATE())) AS total_expense

question: list homework assignments due this week
sql: SELECT h.homework_date, h.submit_date, c.class AS class_name, sec.section AS section_name, sub.name AS subject_name, h.description FROM homework h JOIN classes c ON c.id = h.class_id LEFT JOIN sections sec ON sec.id = h.section_id JOIN subjects sub ON sub.id = h.subject_id WHERE h.submit_date BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) ORDER BY h.submit_date ASC LIMIT 50

question: show homework assigned to grade 3
sql: SELECT h.homework_date, h.submit_date, sub.name AS subject_name, h.description FROM homework h JOIN classes c ON c.id = h.class_id JOIN subjects sub ON sub.id = h.subject_id WHERE (c.class = '3' OR c.class = 'Grade 3' OR c.class = 'Class 3') ORDER BY h.submit_date DESC LIMIT 50

question: which students did not submit homework
sql: SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.lastname) AS student_name, sub.name AS subject_name, h.homework_date, h.submit_date FROM homework h JOIN homework_students hs ON hs.homework_id = h.id JOIN students s ON s.id = hs.student_id JOIN subjects sub ON sub.id = h.subject_id WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(hs.status, '')) IN ('', '0', 'pending', 'not submitted') ORDER BY h.submit_date DESC LIMIT 50

question: give me list of all available courses
sql: SELECT c.id, c.title, c.category, c.status, c.created_at FROM courses c WHERE LOWER(c.status) = 'published' ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT 50

question: how many published courses do we have
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS published_courses FROM courses WHERE LOWER(status) = 'published'

question: show recently uploaded courses
sql: SELECT c.title, c.category, c.status, c.created_at FROM courses c ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT 50

question: list courses taught by teacher Hina Noor
sql: SELECT c.title, c.category, c.status, c.created_at, CONCAT_WS(' ', u.name) AS teacher_name FROM courses c JOIN users u ON u.id = c.teacher_id WHERE LOWER(u.name) LIKE LOWER('%Hina Noor%') ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT 50

question: how many students are enrolled in active courses
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS active_students FROM enrollments e JOIN courses c ON c.id = e.course_id WHERE LOWER(e.status) = 'active' AND LOWER(c.status) = 'published'

question: show students who dropped from courses
sql: SELECT c.title AS course_title, COUNT(*) AS dropped_students FROM enrollments e JOIN courses c ON c.id = e.course_id WHERE LOWER(e.status) = 'dropped' GROUP BY c.title ORDER BY dropped_students DESC LIMIT 50

question: show top students by average quiz score
sql: SELECT u.name AS student_name, ROUND(AVG(q.score), 2) AS avg_score, COUNT(*) AS quizzes_taken FROM quiz_results q JOIN users u ON u.id = q.student_id GROUP BY u.id, u.name ORDER BY avg_score DESC LIMIT 50

question: list students with low quiz scores
sql: SELECT u.name AS student_name, ROUND(AVG(q.score), 2) AS avg_score FROM quiz_results q JOIN users u ON u.id = q.student_id GROUP BY u.id, u.name HAVING AVG(q.score) < 50 ORDER BY avg_score ASC LIMIT 50

question: how many submissions are pending
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS pending_submissions FROM submissions WHERE LOWER(status) = 'pending'

question: list assignments due this week
sql: SELECT a.title, a.due_date, c.title AS course_title FROM assignments a JOIN courses c ON c.id = a.course_id WHERE a.due_date BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) ORDER BY a.due_date ASC LIMIT 50

question: show marksheet of student Bilal Ahmed
sql: SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.lastname) AS student_name, sub.name AS subject_name, ms.exam_marks, ms.exam_total, ms.grade FROM mark_sheet ms JOIN exam_schedule es ON es.id = ms.exam_schedule_id JOIN subjects sub ON sub.id = es.subject_id JOIN students s ON s.id = ms.student_session_id WHERE LOWER(CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.lastname)) LIKE LOWER('%Bilal Ahmed%') ORDER BY sub.name LIMIT 50

question: show exam results for grade 6
sql: SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.lastname) AS student_name, sub.name AS subject_name, ms.exam_marks, ms.exam_total, ms.grade FROM mark_sheet ms JOIN exam_schedule es ON es.id = ms.exam_schedule_id JOIN subjects sub ON sub.id = es.subject_id JOIN student_session ss ON ss.id = ms.student_session_id JOIN students s ON s.id = ss.student_id JOIN classes c ON c.id = ss.class_id WHERE (c.class = '6' OR c.class = 'Grade 6' OR c.class = 'Class 6') ORDER BY s.firstname, sub.name LIMIT 50

question: show recent announcements
sql: SELECT n.title, n.message AS body, n.date FROM notice_board n ORDER BY n.date DESC LIMIT 50

question: list announcements for teachers
sql: SELECT n.title, n.message, n.date FROM notice_board n JOIN notice_roles nr ON nr.notice_id = n.id JOIN roles r ON r.id = nr.role_id WHERE LOWER(r.name) LIKE '%teacher%' ORDER BY n.date DESC LIMIT 50

question: list upcoming events
sql: SELECT e.event_for AS event_name, e.description, e.from_date, e.to_date FROM events e WHERE e.from_date >= CURDATE() ORDER BY e.from_date ASC LIMIT 50

question: list staff leave requests pending approval
sql: SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', s.name, s.surname) AS staff_name, lr.apply_date, lr.from_date, lr.to_date, lr.reason FROM staff_leave_request lr JOIN staff s ON s.id = lr.staff_id WHERE LOWER(lr.status) IN ('pending', 'in progress') ORDER BY lr.apply_date DESC LIMIT 50

question: show staff payroll for this month
sql: SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', s.name, s.surname) AS staff_name, p.basic_salary, p.bonus, p.deduction, p.net_salary, p.payment_date FROM staff_payroll p JOIN staff s ON s.id = p.staff_id WHERE MONTH(p.payment_date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(p.payment_date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) ORDER BY p.payment_date DESC LIMIT 50

question: show students with low attendance
sql: SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.lastname) AS student_name, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(at.type) IN ('p','present') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 2) AS attendance_percent FROM student_attendences sa JOIN student_session ss ON ss.id = sa.student_session_id JOIN students s ON s.id = ss.student_id LEFT JOIN attendence_type at ON at.id = sa.attendence_type_id GROUP BY s.id, student_name HAVING attendance_percent < 75 ORDER BY attendance_percent ASC LIMIT 50

question: show students with no attendance record
sql: SELECT s.firstname, s.lastname, s.admission_no FROM students s LEFT JOIN student_session ss ON ss.student_id = s.id LEFT JOIN student_attendences sa ON sa.student_session_id = ss.id WHERE sa.id IS NULL ORDER BY s.firstname LIMIT 50

question: show fee collection for today
sql: SELECT s.admission_no, CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.lastname) AS student_name, CAST(jt.amt AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS amount, jt.payment_mode, jt.payment_date FROM student_fees_deposite sfd JOIN student_fees_master sfm ON sfm.id = sfd.student_fees_master_id JOIN student_session ss ON ss.id = sfm.student_session_id JOIN students s ON s.id = ss.student_id, JSON_TABLE(sfd.amount_detail, '$.*' COLUMNS (amt VARCHAR(50) PATH '$.amount', payment_mode VARCHAR(50) PATH '$.payment_mode', payment_date DATE PATH '$.date')) AS jt WHERE DATE(jt.payment_date) = CURDATE() ORDER BY jt.payment_date DESC LIMIT 50

question: how many users enrolled in online course Python Basics
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS enrolled_count FROM enrollments e JOIN courses c ON c.id = e.course_id WHERE LOWER(c.title) LIKE LOWER('%Python Basics%')

question: what languages does the system support
sql: SELECT DISTINCT language FROM users WHERE language IS NOT NULL ORDER BY language LIMIT 50

question: what is the current active session
sql: SELECT id, session AS session_name, is_active FROM sessions WHERE is_active = 'yes' LIMIT 1

question: show students grouped by religion
sql: SELECT s.religion, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM students s WHERE s.religion IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.religion ORDER BY student_count DESC LIMIT 50

question: list students by blood group
sql: SELECT s.blood_group, COUNT(*) AS total FROM students s WHERE s.blood_group IS NOT NULL AND s.blood_group != '' GROUP BY s.blood_group ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 50

question: show count of behaviour incidents per student
sql: SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.lastname) AS student_name, COUNT(*) AS incident_count FROM student_incidents si JOIN students s ON s.id = si.student_id GROUP BY s.id, student_name ORDER BY incident_count DESC LIMIT 50

question: show behaviour incidents for grade 7 section B
sql: SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.lastname) AS student_name, sb.title, sb.description, sb.point, si.created_at FROM student_incidents si JOIN students s ON s.id = si.student_id JOIN student_behaviour sb ON sb.id = si.incident_id JOIN student_session ss ON ss.student_id = s.id JOIN classes c ON c.id = ss.class_id JOIN sections sec ON sec.id = ss.section_id WHERE (c.class = '7' OR c.class = 'Grade 7' OR c.class = 'Class 7') AND sec.section = 'B' ORDER BY si.created_at DESC LIMIT 50

question: which teachers teach mathematics
sql: SELECT DISTINCT CONCAT_WS(' ', s.name, s.surname) AS teacher_name, sub.name AS subject_name FROM teacher_subjects ts JOIN staff s ON s.id = ts.staff_id JOIN subjects sub ON sub.id = ts.subject_id WHERE LOWER(sub.name) LIKE '%math%' ORDER BY teacher_name LIMIT 50

question: show library books grouped by category
sql: SELECT bc.book_category, COUNT(b.id) AS total_books FROM books b LEFT JOIN book_category bc ON bc.id = b.book_category WHERE bc.book_category IS NOT NULL GROUP BY bc.book_category ORDER BY total_books DESC LIMIT 50

question: list active transport vehicles
sql: SELECT vehicle_no, vehicle_model, year_made, driver_name, driver_contact, driver_licence FROM transport_vehicle ORDER BY vehicle_no LIMIT 50

question: list open complaints
sql: SELECT c.name AS complainant_name, c.complaint_type, c.description, c.complaint_by, c.contact, c.date FROM complain c WHERE LOWER(c.action_taken) = '' OR c.action_taken IS NULL ORDER BY c.date DESC LIMIT 50

question: list students who received certificates this year
sql: SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.lastname) AS student_name, cert.certificate_name, ci.issue_date FROM certificate_issue ci JOIN certificate cert ON cert.id = ci.certificate_id JOIN students s ON s.id = ci.student_id WHERE YEAR(ci.issue_date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) ORDER BY ci.issue_date DESC LIMIT 50

question: how many ID cards have been generated this month
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS id_cards_count FROM id_card WHERE MONTH(created_at) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(created_at) = YEAR(CURDATE())

question: count users by role
sql: SELECT r.name AS role_name, COUNT(DISTINCT sr.staff_id) AS user_count FROM roles r LEFT JOIN staff_roles sr ON sr.role_id = r.id GROUP BY r.id, r.name ORDER BY user_count DESC LIMIT 50

question: list all languages configured in the system
sql: SELECT l.language, l.short_code, l.is_active FROM languages l ORDER BY l.language LIMIT 50

question: show recent SMS or email communications sent
sql: SELECT subject, message, send_to, send_through, send_date, sent_user_id FROM send_email_sms_history ORDER BY send_date DESC LIMIT 50

question: list students promoted to next class
sql: SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.lastname) AS student_name, c_from.class AS from_class, c_to.class AS to_class, sp.promotion_date FROM student_promotion sp JOIN students s ON s.id = sp.student_id LEFT JOIN classes c_from ON c_from.id = sp.from_class_id LEFT JOIN classes c_to ON c_to.id = sp.to_class_id ORDER BY sp.promotion_date DESC LIMIT 50

question: list students who received transfer certificate
sql: SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.lastname) AS student_name, sd.disable_at AS disable_date, sd.disable_reason FROM student_session ss JOIN students s ON s.id = ss.student_id LEFT JOIN student_disable_reason sd ON sd.student_id = s.id WHERE sd.disable_reason LIKE '%transfer%' ORDER BY sd.disable_at DESC LIMIT 50

question: list available exam terms
sql: SELECT et.name AS exam_term_name, et.description, et.is_publish FROM exam_term et ORDER BY et.id DESC LIMIT 50

question: show online exam results for class 8
sql: SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.lastname) AS student_name, oe.exam, oer.marks, oer.total_marks, oer.percentage FROM onlineexam_results oer JOIN onlineexam oe ON oe.id = oer.exam_id JOIN students s ON s.id = oer.student_id JOIN student_session ss ON ss.student_id = s.id JOIN classes c ON c.id = ss.class_id WHERE (c.class = '8' OR c.class = 'Grade 8' OR c.class = 'Class 8') ORDER BY oer.percentage DESC LIMIT 50

question: list students who have not attempted online exam
sql: SELECT s.firstname, s.lastname, oe.exam FROM students s CROSS JOIN onlineexam oe LEFT JOIN onlineexam_results oer ON oer.student_id = s.id AND oer.exam_id = oe.id WHERE oer.id IS NULL AND oe.exam_from <= CURDATE() AND oe.exam_to >= CURDATE() ORDER BY oe.exam LIMIT 50

question: show postal dispatch records today
sql: SELECT pd.from_title, pd.reference_no, pd.address, pd.note, pd.to_title, pd.date FROM postal_dispatch pd WHERE DATE(pd.date) = CURDATE() ORDER BY pd.date DESC LIMIT 50

question: show postal receive records today
sql: SELECT pr.from_title, pr.reference_no, pr.address, pr.note, pr.to_title, pr.date FROM postal_receive pr WHERE DATE(pr.date) = CURDATE() ORDER BY pr.date DESC LIMIT 50

question: show general phone calls log this week
sql: SELECT pcl.name, pcl.phone, pcl.description, pcl.call_type, pcl.date, pcl.call_duration FROM phone_call_log pcl WHERE pcl.date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) ORDER BY pcl.date DESC LIMIT 50

question: count phone calls by call type this month
sql: SELECT pcl.call_type, COUNT(*) AS total_calls FROM phone_call_log pcl WHERE MONTH(pcl.date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(pcl.date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY pcl.call_type ORDER BY total_calls DESC LIMIT 50

question: how many students have remaining fees
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ss.student_id) AS students_with_remaining FROM student_fees_master sfm JOIN student_session ss ON ss.id = sfm.student_session_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT sfd.student_fees_master_id, SUM(CAST(jt.amt AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS paid FROM student_fees_deposite sfd, JSON_TABLE(sfd.amount_detail, '$.*' COLUMNS (amt VARCHAR(50) PATH '$.amount')) AS jt GROUP BY sfd.student_fees_master_id) p ON p.student_fees_master_id = sfm.id WHERE sfm.amount > COALESCE(p.paid, 0)

question: list students who still owe fees
sql: SELECT s.admission_no, CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.middlename, s.lastname) AS student_name, COALESCE(SUM(sfm.amount), 0) AS billed, COALESCE(SUM(p.paid), 0) AS paid, COALESCE(SUM(sfm.amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(p.paid), 0) AS balance FROM students s JOIN student_session ss ON ss.student_id = s.id JOIN student_fees_master sfm ON sfm.student_session_id = ss.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT sfd.student_fees_master_id, SUM(CAST(jt.amt AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS paid FROM student_fees_deposite sfd, JSON_TABLE(sfd.amount_detail, '$.*' COLUMNS (amt VARCHAR(50) PATH '$.amount')) AS jt GROUP BY sfd.student_fees_master_id) p ON p.student_fees_master_id = sfm.id GROUP BY s.id, s.admission_no, s.firstname, s.middlename, s.lastname HAVING balance > 0 ORDER BY balance DESC LIMIT 50

question: what is the total remaining fee amount across all students
sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sfm.amount), 0) AS total_billed, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CAST(jt.amt AS DECIMAL(10,2))) FROM student_fees_deposite sfd, JSON_TABLE(sfd.amount_detail, '$.*' COLUMNS (amt VARCHAR(50) PATH '$.amount')) AS jt), 0) AS total_paid, COALESCE(SUM(sfm.amount), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CAST(jt.amt AS DECIMAL(10,2))) FROM student_fees_deposite sfd, JSON_TABLE(sfd.amount_detail, '$.*' COLUMNS (amt VARCHAR(50) PATH '$.amount')) AS jt), 0) AS total_outstanding FROM student_fees_master sfm
